# Balrog archive fixtures

Retrieved October 3, 2026 from the public ISFDB copy at:
https://isfdb.stoecker.eu/cgi-bin/ay.cgi?8+1979 through ?8+1985.

Attribution: Al von Ruff and the ISFDB team.
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ .

HTML is retained unchanged for parser regression coverage. The production
parser extracts literary records and normalizes whitespace for display and
identity keys for matching. Duplicate work/category/year rows collapse;
Win maps to Winner while Nomination is preserved. These fixtures are not
bundled in the runtime plugin ZIP.
